meaning:
κατα-γινώσκω
(see: γινώσκω), [in LXX: Deu.25:1 (רָשַׁע hi.), Pro.28:11 (חָקַר), Sir.14:2 19:5 * ;]
to blame, condemn: with genitive of person(s), 1Jn.3:20-21; pass., κατεγνωσμένος ἦν (RV, he stood condemned, see Ellie., in l; but cf. Field, Notes, 188): Gal.2:11.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
